jobs.title: Junior Backend Developer (GoLang\Java)
jobs.description: Junior Backend Developer (GoLang\Java) The best security incidents are the ones detected and prevented in advance. At Skyhawk Security , our security platform identifies exactly those incidents—at scale. We investigate our customers’ cloud infrastructures and alert them to actual incidents in near real-time, so they can be addressed before a full-blown breach occurs. We achieve this with an advanced set of technologies like: Micro-services, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Go, Java, TypeScript, Kubernetes, React, and more. We secure clouds – AWS, GCP, Azure, and more to come! But our key to success is having the best people. This is where you come in. If you have 1–2 years of development experience, preferably in Java or Go , and want to sharpen your skills in cloud security, you’ll fit right in. Experience with cloud environments is a big advantage, but not a must—we’ll help you learn. We provide mentorship, code reviews, and opportunities to work alongside industry experts so you can grow your skills quickly. Who is Skyhawk Security? ~40 employees Backed by Tiger Global Flexible working hours, Hybrid (3 days in office) Located at the Bursa, Ramat Gan – just a short walk from the train station Your Day-to-Day: As a Junior GoLang/Java Backend Developer, you will: Collaborate with senior developers, DevOps engineers, cyber researchers, and data scientists. Contribute to implementing backend security features under guidance and mentorship. Learn and apply agile methodologies and basic project management practices. Gain hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies and distributed systems. Explore our technology stack: Kubernetes, AWS, SQL/NoSQL databases (Elasticsearch, Neo4j), Apache Iceberg, and more. Write and maintain code in Go or Java, building microservices in a domain-driven architecture. What We Expect From You: 1–2 years of coding experience, ideally professional but some personal projects also count, preferably in Java or Go. A quick learner with a “can-do” attitude. Willingness to ask questions and seek guidance when needed. Team player who enjoys problem-solving and tackling challenges. Curiosity about cloud technologies and eagerness to expand your skills. Eagerness to learn from feedback and continuously improve. Bonus Points For (Nice to have): Some experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with Python. A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Interest in cybersecurity concepts. If you don’t tick every box, that’s okay — we value potential and eagerness to learn. Our Culture: We believe great work comes from great people working in the right environment. Our values guide us: Thinking without a Box – we push beyond conventional solutions. Passion for Excellence – we aim for the highest standards, driven by passion. Guided by Purpose – we choose our goals with focus and clarity. Driven by Care – we care about our work and our people. Embracing Openness – we listen, accept, and collaborate with openness. Job Location: Ramat Gan, Israel
